thanks, Peter.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <31bff...@news.rz.uni-passau.de>,

Peter Seidenhofer <seid...@vati.fmi.uni-passau.de> wrote:
>
>I guess my Jyhad-version from "The Second Tradition: Domain" has a card erratra. So I'am sure that I played it wrong till now. Is anyone able to tell me how this card exactly works.
>

Yes, it has errata that it can only be used by a Tapped Prince/Justicar.
As with any intercept-gaining reaction card, it con only be played
if you have a lower intercept than the acting minion's current stealth.

So, you can't play it for the intercept if you are untapped.
And you can't play it for the untap if the acting minion isn't at stealth.

(Nor can your play it if you have a raven spy unless the acting minion
is at +2 or more stealth).
